title: REST API scaffolding: Axum server + daily leaderboard endpoint
description: Wire up Axum alongside the Discord bot in main.rs, sharing the existing Repository. Add tower-http (CORS, timeout, security headers) and tower-governor (rate limiting). Expose GET /leaderboard/daily as the first endpoint to prove the pattern. This unblocks maptapbot-14l.
close_reason: Axum server scaffolding implemented with GovernorLayer (per-IP rate limiting), CORS, timeouts, security headers, and GET /leaderboard/daily endpoint. All 62 tests pass.

title: Frontend for insights with data & graphs
description:
# Frontend for maptapbot

By now I've got quite some data in the database I'd like to create a frontend for.

## Theme

This is a fun site meant to give some insights and some laughs here and there. It's all lighthearted.

## REST API

Data will be retrieved through a REST API. The Swagger docs will be provided later.

## Auth

The site and data will all be public.

## General description of the site

The homepage should show the daily leaderboard. That's the most important data to show.

People can switch between daily, weekly and permanent leaderboards (these modes are provided as such by the REST Api, no need to calculate on FE).

Let's start by this, and see how we grow beyond this.

title: Add REST Api
description:
I want to create a REST API.

The end goal is maptapbot-5ph.

Recommend me some approaches on how to handle REST Api with rust.

All of the data is public. Rate limiting should be implemented.

We need the other appropriate security measures in place, list to me what you will implement.
